title: Finite Q3 commutator-sum Lie-Trotter defect and two-orientation history bound
question: For the declared finite Q3 split Hamiltonians, does an explicit commutator-sum Lie-Trotter defect bound control both product orders and both time signs, and does the induced two-orientation history admit the corresponding finite operator-norm bound?

adversarial_review.check: The finite bound is derived from a unitary Duhamel interpolation and the exact pairwise commutator sum; no empirical slope is substituted for the inequality.
Disjoint tensor supports are assigned zero commutator and overlapping terms are evaluated on their union support; one full-matrix embedding residual is checked per volume.
Both declared product orders and both time signs are tested against the same exact full-Hamiltonian exponential; the bound is order/sign agnostic only after the finite commutator sum is computed.
The history estimate retains the factor 2 from the two-sided adjoint difference and the exact sum of k=0,...,N-1; it is not inferred from the final-unitary error alone.
The computed C_V values and finite bounds are reported by volume; no finite list is promoted to a volume-uniform estimate.
Bounded finite matrices do not supply a common unbounded-operator core, thermodynamic Cauchy estimate, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A closure.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks exact rational coefficients and the finite sum factor only; matrix commutators, unbounded domains and all QFT limits remain Python/open analysis.

qft_interface.closed: For each declared finite Q3 graph, the exact pairwise commutator sum gives a proven finite unitary defect bound and a derived two-orientation history operator-norm bound for both split orders and time signs.
qft_interface.open: Uniform control of C_V under volume/cutoff/source changes, common operator domains, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary C6/Q3 evidence only; no TECT production owner, physical-empty reference or Sector-A closure is supplied.

no_overclaim: This package proves only a bounded finite-matrix commutator-sum rate and its finite history consequence. It does not prove a volume-uniform Q3 dynamics, an infinite-dimensional Trotter theorem, common alpha, or any C6, Sector A or Pre-A closure.
